verdict.rationale: The docs say CodeRabbit is set up in about two minutes with a GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps or Bitbucket account, and starts reviewing 'within moments' of a PR opening. Reviews post actionable inline comments, a walkthrough comment and one-click suggestions on the PR. Community reports corroborate real use on GitHub PRs, including that it runs as a GitHub App and posts review comments. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of the 'within minutes' timing and of the GitLab merge-request inline-comment experience specifically.
